result.brief: 提出 Drift Variation 自编码器，用条件后验流匹配统一生成与表征学习，证明后验充分性下表征缺陷为零，实现生成充分潜空间。
result.reason: Trains masked encoder with conditional flow decoder, unifying generation and generatively sufficient representation learning via posterior-sufficient latent; directly matches RAE/generative latent and representation learning interests.
